changelog: Affiliate portal: a customer whose first recorded payment was invalid (zero amount or another currency) no longer shows an "unlimited" commission window — `customerWindows()` now reads the window from the first valid payment, as the engine does (#3729).

en: Partner portal: a customer's commission end date is shown correctly even when an invalid payment was recorded first.
tr: Partner portalı: önce geçersiz bir ödeme kaydedilmiş olsa da müşterinin komisyon bitiş tarihi doğru gösteriliyor.
de: Partnerportal: Das Provisionsende eines Kunden wird richtig angezeigt, auch wenn zuerst eine ungültige Zahlung erfasst wurde.
